assets.name: theme-trail-sign
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production asset for existing hand-painted storybook hackathon hillside. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: warm irregular dark reddish-brown ink outlines, restrained gouache shading, hand-brushed timber grain, cream/leaf-green/rust palette. Genuine transparent alpha background including gaps between posts. One whole isolated freestanding object with full feet visible and a small transparent safety margin. Almost frontal view, just enough visible top and right thickness for convincing depth. No ground, sky, buildings, people, logos, text, numerals, or backdrop shadow. Not photorealistic or glossy 3D. Subject: a sturdy small wooden trail sign on two short thick timber posts. Broad rounded rectangular warm cream-painted sign face, rustic layered natural-wood border with 4 dark bolts and tiny leaf-green corner accents. Front FACE must be a SINGLE EMPTY uninterrupted light cream area for real HTML theme lettering, no divider lines or decorations over its center. Face should take about x12% to88%, y12% to56% of the full object. Two separate rooted posts continue below the sign to full ground line at bottom, subtle back braces, open transparent space between the posts. Entire object width about 1.25 times its full height. No roof, no corkboard, no ropes, no additional objects. Keep enough simple clear cream face to carry heading, theme title, and a short description.

assets.name: gallery-trail-kiosk
assets.prompt: Edit this trailhead kiosk. Keep its style, green shingle roof, wood grain, frontal angle, two metal-footed timber posts, palette and genuine alpha background. Change ONLY the proportions to give much more room to the cork display: enlarge the blank cork face so its clear area occupies x18% to82% and y22% to81% of the full object. Remove the open gap between roof and top frame, make the roof shallower and reduce exposed leg length below the frame. Frame should be a broad generous bulletin board, not skinny; full object still roughly square/slightly taller than wide. Large blank cork surface is the priority, ready for a photo gallery. Do not add any photos, paper, lettering, pins, people, scenery, shadows on background, or extra objects. Fully visible kiosk including feet. Preserve actual transparency including empty spaces between legs.
assets.originalPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production asset for existing hand-painted storybook hackathon hillside. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: warm irregular dark reddish-brown ink outlines, restrained gouache shading, hand-brushed timber grain, cream/leaf-green/rust palette. Genuine transparent alpha background including gaps between posts. One whole isolated freestanding object with full feet visible and a small transparent safety margin. Almost frontal view, just enough visible top and right thickness for convincing depth. No ground, sky, buildings, people, logos, text, numerals, or backdrop shadow. Not photorealistic or glossy 3D. Subject: ONE national-park trailhead information kiosk, a large cork bulletin board held by TWO stout natural timber posts with visible rear diagonal braces and a shallow small pitched forest-green shingle roof. Large clean EMPTY warm tan cork face with fine subdued cork texture and wooden frame. No papers, maps, pins, photos, symbols or text: the face is completely empty so a web page can overlay real photo cards. The large unobstructed face must occupy about x13% to87%, y20% to77% of the full object; roof occupies only top~16%, feet extend to bottom with short exposed legs. Full object height about 1.05 times width, roomy large near-square cork display, NOT a tall narrow notice stand. Slightly visible roof depth and right edge, no strong perspective tilt. The post feet stand at same baseline. No surrounding landscape, ground or fake checkerboard.
